records.text: Hamas has no control in the West Bank, where 37 Palestinian children had been killed through August and 7,000 Palestinians had been killed since the occupation.
records.speaker: Bassem Youssef

appearances.snippet: Hamas has absolutely no control in the West Bank and this is the beginning of this street. ... Only through August, ... 37 Palestinian kids were killed. ... No music festival, ... no paragliding, ... no Hamas. Since the occupation of the West Bank, ... 7,000 Palestinians were killed.

verification.notes: The Palestinian Authority, not Hamas, administers parts of the West Bank, though Hamas maintains political and militant presence there. A contemporaneous child-rights report counted 37 Palestinian children killed across the occupied Palestinian territory by early August 2023, not solely the West Bank; the asserted 7,000-since-occupation total was not substantiated.

records.text: In three weeks after the ceasefire, more Palestinian children were killed than Israeli children had been killed over 75 years.
records.speaker: Bassem Youssef

appearances.snippet: In three weeks, they killed more children from the Palestinian side more than Israeli kids were killed all through 75 years.

verification.notes: A post-ceasefire report counted 67 Palestinian children killed in the relevant weeks. Israeli National Insurance data records hundreds of Israeli child and youth victims of hostile actions over the state’s history, so the comparison claiming the three-week Palestinian total exceeded 75 years of Israeli child deaths is false.

verification.notes: Palantir, co-founded and chaired by Peter Thiel and led by Alex Karp, entered a strategic partnership to provide technology for Israel’s war-related missions; Larry Ellison separately made a record donation supporting IDF facilities. records.text: Zionists purchased views, influencers, and journalists, activated millions of bots, and staged a takeover of TikTok because young people sympathized with Palestine.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Over the last three years, especially we have watched Zionists bend the fabric of reality. They have purchase views, influencers, and journalists. ... They have activated millions of online bots. They even went so far as to stage an open takeover of TikTok when they grew incensed that the youth was sympathetic to Palestine.

verification.notes: Transcript context at 37:10 is a broad composite accusation. Current FARA-based research documents Israeli-funded influencer campaigns and a bot-based amplification program, and TikTok's U.S. business was transferred to a new investor group after federal divestiture pressure. But available evidence does not establish millions of activated bots, a unified group called 'Zionists' purchasing journalists, or that the TikTok ownership deal was staged specifically because youth sympathized with Palestine. Some components are supported; the sweeping causal framing is not.

sources.title: The Eighth Front: Inside Israel's $1 Billion Influence Campaign
sources.relevance: FARA-based research documents paid influencers and a bot-based pro-Israel amplification program, but not the full sweeping claim.

sources.title: TikTok signs deal to form new US unit with investors, including Oracle, Silver Lake
sources.relevance: Confirms the U.S. TikTok ownership transfer and its statutory context, without establishing the asserted Palestine-related motive.

verification.notes: Haifa was part of Mandatory Palestine in 1937, making the account historically plausible, but the cited private birth certificate is not available and no independent record located verifies Kasparian grandmother exact birthplace and year.

records.text: Jared Kushner and Benjamin Netanyahu had a plan to stage a fake October 7 incident and use victimhood claims to wipe out an entire population.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: They had a vision. It was a look at all this land in Palestine. We kind of need a fake incident called October 7th in which we are the masters of it. ... And then we're going to claim to be victims. Then we're going to wipe out an entire population.

verification.notes: Independent UN and Human Rights Watch investigations found that the October 7 attack was premeditated, coordinated, and carried out by Hamas and other Palestinian armed groups. Those evidence-based findings directly contradict the claim that Kushner and Netanyahu staged a fake incident; no evidence of such a plan was found.

sources.title: UN Independent Commission of Inquiry Report A/HRC/56/26
sources.relevance: Finds Hamas and other Palestinian armed groups carried out the October 7 attacks and committed war crimes, directly contradicting the staged-fake-event claim.

sources.title: Human Rights Watch: Palestinian Armed Groups October 7 Assault on Israel
sources.relevance: Independent evidence review documents a coordinated, planned assault by Hamas-led armed groups.

records.text: Candace Owens said Australia banned her for standing up for Palestinians and innocent Palestinian life.
